flags.message: The snapshot shows a petitioner's supplemental brief docketed September 11, 2026 (Rule 15.8, reporting a July 21, 2026 state trial-court order affirming the zoning board) and a June 18, 2026 waiver of response, but documents.json provisioned only the petition and its QP section. I fetched the supplemental brief from its supremecourt.gov link (forward cell); it carries no intervening decision of this Court and did not move the forecast. Consider provisioning Rule 15.8 supplemental briefs alongside the petition and BIO.
